glossary.meaning: A constant value equal to approximately $2.898 \times 10^{-3} \text{ m}\cdot\text{K}$, derived from fundamental constants.
The wavelength at which a blackbody emits maximum spectral radiance.
The temperature of the blackbody measured in Kelvin (K).
\lambda_{max} T = b (Valid for ideal blackbody radiation)
